methodology: First-token latency (TTFT) in milliseconds, warm caches. Cloud values are median TTFT from Artificial Analysis (an independent benchmarking project) for premium chat models. Local values are from community benchmarks on a 128 GB unified-memory APU class system running a 14B-class instruction-tuned model at 4-bit quantization.
source_label: public benchmarks · run scripts/run_langfuse_export.py to swap in your own Langfuse traces

datasets.description: Short conversational prompt (~200 tokens), no retrieval

cloud.source: premium cloud chat model · median TTFT
